mapper.select: select pl.id, pl.dates, pl.pkg, pl.country, pl.version, pl.user_num from dws_daily_package_login pl inner join dim_channel c on (c.pkg = pl.pkg) where pl.dates = #{dates} and c.project_id = #{productId}
select dates, pkg, country, version, count(DISTINCT user_id) user_num from dwd_user_login_record where dates = #{dates} group by dates, pkg, country, version
